<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, two at 131.30, 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and two at 116.65 ppm. Counting each carbon represented by these signals gives 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
